Opposition Walks Out of All-Party Meet Over TMC Rebel Invite

Opposition parties staged a walkout from an all-party meeting ahead of the Monsoon Session of Parliament. The protest was against the government's decision to invite a breakaway faction of the Trinamool Congress. The government stated that all groups must be included, while some opposition members questioned the invitation and called for a new anti-defection law.
